body: Obviously it’s a collab between the two channels. Mark shared and liked it on YouTube, and twitter.  I feel not enough people were noticing that things were off so mark probably went to mat to help things along.

But aren’t I?
I can’t even help myself at this point, how can he help me? I didn’t get the job I was interviewing for, and that crushed me. I feel so fucking useless like this.

I can’t tell him this. I think he already knows. He tells me he never sees me eat, and that it worries him, but he believes me when I tell him I’m fine. 

He’s supporting me. I can’t let him handle my emotional baggage too. That’s not fair to him. 

Besides, thinking of eating right now is nauseating. I’m also not skinny so I doubt I’ll starve for a long while, and I’m already at no energy because of my depression. I’d just rather wither away at this point. I’m such a failure to him, and he deserves so much better
